description: RTS Bus Stops Fall 2021 is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. RTS Bus Stops Fall 2021 data is provided by Regional Transit System department. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Mobility. Its tags are 2021, bus stop inventory, rts. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: RTS. The portal shows 2021-09-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
